note: A self-assessment by the participant that built this surface. It establishes BUILT and witnesses nothing. Bdo asked for controls on the automation page and for the result to be AI-native; this reading says which axes that actually reached and which it did not. The one that decides the verdict is not a technical axis: earn_it is a human judgement and it is his.

reachability.note: A fresh model instance can find the operation, its inputs, its constraints and its result without reading source. contracts/automation-control.json declares the operation, both directions, the effect class of each, the grant each needs, the record shape and all eight refusals. `python scripts/sov_schedule.py --help` lists enable, disable, switches and console; each verb states its own arguments. The result is a typed outcome with a refusal code from the declared set, and `switches --json` returns the record. Nothing about this operation requires a human to read the page or to translate anything.

commitment.note: A model's request and accepted state are not the same thing and cannot be confused. A model asking to arm a schedule produces outcome PROPOSED with refusal_code GRANT_NOT_HELD, the declaration is untouched, and the asking is recorded. Only an actor holding seat:root moves the switch, and the record distinguishes EFFECTED from PROPOSED from REFUSED from the no-op that wrote nothing at all. C-002 is the defeating case: if it ever passes, any session on this box can commit the owner's tokens.

provenance.note: Every attempt resolves to who, when, through which binding, from which value to which, why, and the digest of the declaration before and after. What it cannot resolve is identity: the console authenticates nobody, so an actor at this machine is recorded as a local operator holding the root seat by possession of the box. That is what was actually checked, and the record says so rather than naming a person. FULL needs a principal this surface can verify, which does not exist yet on this node.

retraction.note: A switch is countered by a further switch in the opposite direction and the earlier record stays. Nothing is edited and nothing is removed. It is PARTIAL rather than FULL because the counteraction is record-local only and honest about it: switching a schedule off does not counter a run that already happened and refunds nothing that run spent. The contract says this in record.retraction.honesty rather than letting the reversal read as a rollback.

earn_it.note: The question is whether removing the model path removes a material capability or only an alternate control surface. The honest argument each way is short. For SUBSTANTIVE: a model operator switching a failing schedule off during an incident, and recording a proposal to arm one, is the operating loop this system is for, and the page is a second binding onto it rather than the other way round. For BOLTED_ON: seven declarations on one box, no schedule armed, nothing ticking them, and a human who could edit the JSON by hand in less time than it takes to read this. Nobody but Bdo settles that, and OPEN is not a favourable result - it caps the verdict below AI_NATIVE no matter how the technical axes score.

derived.note: Derived, never selected. reachability >= PARTIAL holds and three structural axes are at PARTIAL or better, so the arithmetic would reach AI_NATIVE - but earn_it is OPEN, which makes the assessment state OPEN and leaves the verdict underived. Recording the score it would have reached is not the same as having reached it, and this line exists so nobody reports the first as the second.

same_world_parity.note: One function, two bindings. The page's button and the command line call control.set_switch and nothing else, so the authority check cannot be reached around by either. A test drives both against the same schedule and asserts the log records the same shape from each, differing only in the binding field. Hiding a button is explicitly not the check.

typed_authority.note: Scoped: seat:root, and only for ENABLE. Attributable: the actor is in every record. Checked at the operation, not at the binding. Revocable in the sense that matters here - the grant table is data and a test proves flipping it changes the outcome, so the check is the table rather than a hard-coded branch. Verification authority ratifies nothing: the operation settles whether a switch moved, never whether it should have.

independent_observation.note: The tests establish BUILT. Nothing here has been observed by a participant that did not build it. This is the axis the previous packet on this surface owed and paid, and this one owes again.

receipt_completeness.note: Every admission, refusal and operation leaves a durable line, including the refusals - which is the part usually missing. What it is not is a kernel receipt: this log is a harness record, it carries no receipt_id and no authority_grant_ids, and the kernel does not settle it. Calling it a receipt would be the misreport this line exists to prevent.

effect_honesty.note: The two directions carry different effect classes because they are different effects, and the contract says why. Disabling is never described as undoing a run. Arming is never described as running: the surface says armed, because nothing on this node ticks a schedule and an operator who read on as running would be wrong.

cold_start_competence.note: Not measured. A fresh instance reading contracts/automation-control.json and the CLI help has what it needs in principle, and nobody has timed one doing it.

two_binding_proof.note: test_the_served_page_and_the_command_line_reach_one_operation drives the human binding over HTTP and the model binding in process against the same schedule and the same contract, and asserts both land in the same log. The human binding is exercised through the real socket, not a stub.

local_sovereignty.note: No integration is involved. The operation reads and writes files in this repository, the transport is a loopback socket, and losing Claude, GitHub or any network removes nothing: the command line still switches schedules and the log is committed, so the record survives cloning.

model_substitutability.note: No model is invoked by this operation at all, so the axis has nothing to grade. Marking it PASS on the grounds that nothing can go wrong would be reading an absence as a proof.

qualifications.qualification_note: Derived. SOVERAEIGN_QUALIFIED needs a complete AI_NATIVE assessment and PASS on every check. earn_it is OPEN so the assessment is not complete, and four checks are UNPROVEN or PARTIAL. UNPROVEN is not a pass and is left visible.

defeating_cases: scripts/tests/test_automation_control.py::ConsoleTransport - a non-loopback bind, and a wrong token moving a switch
